record: Arithmetic re-check of the saved LCL outputs with a second implementation.
scope: A second implementation of the arithmetic, written within the same study, run on the same saved LCL forecasts and targets. It is not an independent review, not an external confirmation and not a new test.
limitations: The forecasts were not recomputed, and the level was not rebuilt independently.
The raw source was not checked again: the time at which data arrived, later revisions, the physical meaning of the hours and the pretraining data of the foundation models are not certified.
The bootstrap carries no coverage guarantee under time dependence.
Nothing was repaired or reselected for accuracy.

study_workspace_hashes.note: SHA-256 of two records of the study workspace, which are not in this repository.
